_meta.description: Operator configuration — Phase 0 deliverable 0.8. All parameters are binding once set. Changes require AIMS Mode A log entry.

operating_windows.description: Hours during which the operator is available to review Confirmation Gate items

emergency_window.description: For CRITICAL escalations only — any time

unavailability_protocol.description: If operator is unavailable, items queue in Review Queue. No auto-approve on timeout. Silence ≠ approval.
unavailability_protocol.overflow_action: flag in AIMS Mode A; alert operator at next available window

review_capacity_ceiling.description: Maximum Confirmation Gate items in the Review Queue at any time. Phase 7 proposal generation pauses when this is exceeded.

materiality_threshold.description: Findings with estimated financial impact above this threshold automatically route through Confirmation Gate before AIMS Mode B delivery

notification_preferences.note: HIGH/CRITICAL notification channels cannot be disabled — Design Invariant enforcement

algorithmic_rule.description: 10% of all investigation cycles redirected to counter-intuitive hypotheses from Constraint Register. Analyst may adjust percentage. System cannot skip these cycles.

model_selection.description: Always use strongest frontier model. Non-negotiable. No fallback to lighter models. Bumped from claude-opus-4-6 to claude-opus-4-8 per C-038 (Session 19), matching lib/llm_wrapper.py REQUIRED_MODEL.
